# Forge
STOP. As soon as you finish reading this document, your first to-do is read FORGE_ARCHITECTURE.MD.

> A from-scratch B-Rep geometry kernel in Rust, built for correctness, determinism, and AI-assisted development. IMPORTANT: Being designed as an aerospace-grade parasolid competitor. Ambitious? Yes. But that means we cant do code hacks. Everything must be clean and well-architected. 

## Project Overview

- READ THIS [Forge Architecture](FORGE_ARCHITECTURE.md): Architecture Pre-spec — components, dependencies, and hybrid pipeline.
- [Proof System](PROOF_SYSTEM.md): Internal certainty specification — 5 proof layers and validation suites.


## Documentation

- [Crate Overview](CRATE_OVERVIEW.md): Comprehensive reference guide for all crates and their exact responsibilities.
- [Boolean Upgrade Spec](BooleanUpgradeSpec.MD): Engineering specification for exact boolean operations.
- [Topology Queries Spec](TOPO_QUERIES_SPEC.md): Specification for topological extraction and queries.
- [Tolerance Policy](docs/tolerance-policy.md): ModelingContext tolerance infrastructure.
- [File Naming Dictionary](docs/FILE_NAMING.md): Deterministic naming conventions for source files.

## Crate Map

- `forge-math`: Exact predicates, rational arithmetic, linear algebra (no internal deps).
- `forge-core`: Shared types, error definitions, policy language, tracing envelope (depends on math).
- `forge-geom`: Stateless geometry solvers, bounding volumes, spatial trees (depends on core).
- `forge-signal`: Reactive dependency graph, evaluation engine (depends on core).
- `forge-topo`: Topology arena, generational handles, Euler operators (depends on geom, core).
- `forge-kernel`: Features, booleans, policy decisions, tolerance config (depends on topo, geom, core).
- `forge-io`: JSON import/export, serialization schemas (depends on kernel/topo/geom/math).
- `forge-test`: Differential test harness, random generators (test-only, depends on all).
- `forge-schema`: Declarative modeling JSON schema (no kernel deps).
- `forge-repr`: Representation types for rendering like TriangleMesh (no kernel deps).
- `forge-view`: Trace viewer GUI app and CLI inspector (depends on core).

## Core Concepts & Key Types

Status: ✔ implemented, ◐ partially implemented, ○ future

### 1. Exact Arithmetic (forge-math) ✔
- `TriSign` — Neg/Zero/Pos tri-valued predicate result
- `CertifiedTriSign` — only constructable inside forge-math, proves sign was mathematically verified
- `Rational` — exact BigInt/BigInt rational for planar Stage 3A fallback

### 2. Errors & Policy (forge-core) ✔
- `KernelError` — primary error type for all crates above forge-math
- `PolicyResult<T>` — three-state return: Ok / Ambiguous / Err (for escalation)
- `PolicyKind` — CoincidentGeometry / NearTangency / SliverFace / etc.

### 3. Tracing & Decisions (forge-core) ✔
- `TracedDecision` — a single logged kernel decision with kind, tier, margin, threshold
- `DecisionKind` — Exact / NearBoundary / PolicyApplied / PrecisionEscalation / Forced
- `DecisionTier` — Routine / NearBoundary / PolicyApplied / Escalated
- `DecisionLog` — span-based decision trace with open/close events and summary
- `DivergenceReport` — scan for float vs exact disagreements

### 4. Result Envelope (forge-core) ✔
- `OperationResult<T>` — universal return wrapper: value + DecisionLog + warnings + metrics + lineage delta + state hashes. Auto-persists traces when `FORGE_TRACE_DIR` is set.

### 5. Tolerance (forge-kernel) ✔
- `ToleranceConfig` — all numeric thresholds bundled: spatial, angular, tangency, sliver, gap, precision
- `TolerancePolicy` — spatial + angular coincidence thresholds
- `TangencyPolicy` — near-tangent surface intersection handling
- `SliverPolicy` — min face area and max slivers per operation
- `GapClosurePolicy` — gap healing limits
- `PrecisionEscalationPolicy` — fuel caps for Stage 3B arbitrary precision
- `ModelingContext` — the policy engine: holds all tolerance policies, decision log, and validation config
- `ToleranceProvider` trait (forge-core) — per-entity tolerance query interface so forge-topo can ask "how close is close enough?" without owning geometry

### 6. Topology State & Transactions (forge-topo) ✔
- `TopologyState` — immutable snapshot with epoch, topology_version, geometry_version, topology_hash
- `MutableDraft` — transactional mutation handle; commit or drop (auto-rollback)
- `TopologyArena` — the actual halfedge data store

### 7. Typed Handles (forge-topo) ✔
- `FaceId`, `HalfEdgeId`, `VertexId`, `LoopId`, `EdgeId`, `BodyId`, `ShellId`, `LumpId`, `RegionId`
- Generational `(index, generation)` pairs — stale access detected immediately

### 8. Hierarchy (forge-topo) ✔
- Body → Lump → Region → Shell → Face → Loop → HalfEdge → Vertex
- Euler formula validated per solid: `V - E + F = 2(S - G) + R`

### 9. Euler Operators (forge-topo) ✔
- `MakeVertexFace`, `MakeEdgeFace`, `MakeEdgeVertex`, `SplitEdge`, `JoinFaces`, `KillEdgeVertex`, `SewEdge`, `UnsewEdge`, `MakeEdgeKillLoop`, `KillEdgeMakeLoop`, `MakeShellFace`, `KillShellFace`, `MakeFaceFromVertices`, etc.
- All atomic, all go through `apply_op()` with lineage logging

### 10. Lineage & Provenance (forge-topo) ✔
- `Lineage` — provenance: origin features, creation op, deterministic ancestry hash (Merkle DAG)
- `OpSignature` — operation name + invocation ID for replay
- `LineageEvent` — EntityCreated / EntityDeleted / EntityModified events

### 11. Validation & Integrity (forge-topo) ✔
- Structural checks: twin reciprocity, loop closure, vertex continuity, Euler formula
- Geometric checks: zero-area faces, zero-length edges, signed volume, degenerate loops
- Orientation healing: auto-flip inverted shells
- Manifold enforcement: solid shells require edge valence exactly 2

### 12. Geometry (forge-geom) ✔
- `Plane` — analytic plane
- `PlaneSet` — Vec<Plane> implementing GeometrySource (test double)
- `BspTree` / `BspConfig` — BSP spatial partitioning for convex polyhedra
- `BvhNode` / `Aabb` — bounding volume hierarchy for spatial queries

### 13. Boolean Operations (forge-kernel) ◐
- `BooleanInput` / `BooleanOp` / `BooleanResult` / `execute_boolean`
- Dual pipeline: **Ember** (fast BSP-based, planar-only) and **Classic** (robust face-splitting pipeline designed to handle planes correctly now so it extends cleanly to curves later)
- Currently supports planar Union/Intersection/Subtraction; active upgrade for exact coplanar handling and robust face splitting

### 14. Features (forge-kernel) ◐
- `FeatureTree` — parametric feature graph
- `NativeFeature` — enum of all features (MakeCube, Boolean, etc.)
- `Feature` trait / `FeatureOutput` — feature interface

### 15. Mesh Building (forge-kernel) ✔
- `build_halfedge_mesh` / `make_cube` / `MeshBuildResult` — BSP → halfedge mesh construction

### 16. Signal Graph (forge-signal) ✔
- `SignalGraph` / `NodeId` — reactive dependency graph for feature invalidation
- `mark_dirty` / `evaluate` — push/pull evaluation

### 17. Serialization (forge-io) ✔
- `save_model` / `load_model` — JSON persistence
- `diff_models` — model diffing

## Future Milestones

- **Curved Geometry** — NURBS surfaces, surface-surface intersection, coedges (UV trim curves), tolerant vertices
- **Dual-Path Verification** — independent winding-number vs ray-cast point-in-solid cross-check
- **Precision Escalation Pipeline** — float → interval → rational auto-escalation with `PrecisionEscalation` tracking
- **Causal Replay & Witnesses** — `CausalChain` reconstruction, counterfactual replay, delta-debug minimal region extraction
- **Self-Consistency Fuzzing** — Boolean identity combinators (commutativity, associativity, cancellation), adversarial mutation engine
- **Persistent Naming** — selectors that find entities by lineage ancestry
- **STEP/IGES Import/Export** — currently JSON-only
